Post 1

📈 Energy cratered 3.45% while the rest of the market partied. ASX 200 added 30.30 pts (+0.34%) to 8,886.80 — a split session where sector divergence told the real story. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🔺 A-REITs led at +2.85%, Consumer Discretionary close behind at +1.87%. 🔻 Energy the clear loser, down 3.45%. Rate-cut hopes lifting property; falling commodity prices punishing fuel. #ASX #energy #property

Post 3

QAN surged +6.36% to AUD 9.36 — one of the session's sharpest moves. Lower energy costs are a direct tailwind for airline margins. When oil slides, Qantas wins. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 5,626.22/oz. Silver AUD 70.62/oz. AUD/USD sitting at 0.6986. Metals steady but energy weakness drove the sector narrative today. #gold #silver #commodities #ASX

Post 5

Watch Energy. The sector dropped 3.45% today — if commodity prices don't stabilise, that drag widens. Does crude find a floor this week, or does Energy extend losses into a third session? Your call. #ASX #energy #ausbiz
